summary: 052 proves the exact final D03 Reviewer Guidance gap and a bounded solution: three self-contained canonical product Reviewer entries plus independent non-delegating bootstrap parity, with temporary Run-bridge cleanup only after coverage. Existing Core already supports reviewer Standard Actions, role mapping, canonical Guidance identity, ActionPackage semantics, and Run persistence. No Core, lifecycle, dependency, Registry/Router/Planner/Runtime, self-hosting migration, Memo mutation, or per-Change architecture expansion is required.
